story: As a speaker using the app, I want the server's front door (sign-in, job progress, uploads, error answers) to behave the same every time, so that the app never breaks on it or shows me someone else's job.
outcomes:
O1  The paths the website and Railway call exist, and the health check
answers "ok".
O2  Without a valid sign-in, a protected page answers a clear "not signed
in" the app can read.
O3  A guest or the owner can follow their own processing job; someone
else's job looks exactly like no job at all.
O4  Errors come back in a form the app can read, never as a web page.
O5  The browser's pre-upload check accepts every header the app sends,
so big deck uploads go through.
O6  Without a sign-in, the provider diagnostics answer "not signed in"
and never ask OpenAI.
proves:
O1 -> test_critical_routes_are_wired, test_health_endpoints_answer_200
O2 -> test_protected_route_without_header_is_401_json,
test_protected_route_non_bearer_is_401_json,
test_protected_route_garbage_token_is_401_json
O3 -> test_guest_job_polls_anonymously,
test_owned_job_polls_with_bearer,
test_foreign_job_and_unknown_job_are_indistinguishable,
test_non_uuid_job_id_is_404_without_db

test_413_handler_is_registered_and_answers_json

story: As a coach, I want to be asked to listen again only for clips I judged blind, once at a time, with a fresh line each time, so that my second answer is still my own and not prompted by the machine.
outcomes:
O1  The flag opens one ask per coach with a blind judgment of record and
none for a self-report, a peer, an abstention, an anonymous row or a
coach whose rating was not blind; no second ask while one is open.
O2  The coach's new answer closes their ask; the next flag opens a new one
with the next signed line (A then B) and the closed ask stays as history.
O3  Never-2: the ask carries no reason, answer or machine read, by the
table's shape (only take, moment, coach, line key and two times).
why: 0444 (QG12a A, P26c): the coach's second answer must stay blind.

story: As a coach, I want to change my answer to a speaker's request and have every earlier answer kept, so that I can correct myself without losing the record.
outcomes:
O1  Giving the same answer again changes nothing.
O2  A different answer replaces what the speaker sees; the old one, with
its words, video and share, is kept as version 1, 2, 3.
O3  A new answer that is not shared withdraws the earlier share.
O4  Changing from words to an exercise keeps the answer well-formed.
why: Coach panel lock flows 7 and 12; Q-B12 A (migration 0446).

story: As the founder, I want a coach's chosen exercise frozen once, with the reason it was chosen, and its showing receipted, so that what the speaker practises is traceable and never silently swapped.
outcomes:
O1  A coach pick is frozen once (a replay naming another exercise returns
the first row) under the coach policy, with no seed and no draw.
O2  Its match trace is stored once, with outcome coach_chosen.
O3  Showing the card is receipted once against that frozen pick; a card
for another exercise is refused by name.
why: Migration 0398 (founder 2026-09-29, decision 3). Runs only on a disposable database whose name starts with willab_confident_moment_.

story: As the founder, I want a confidence event whose Take has no clip a rater could judge to be given up for good, so that the outbox stops claiming and failing it every 30 seconds (two events, 30,903 attempts since 2026-10-08) and keeps the record of why.
outcomes:
O1  An event the worker gives up is never claimed again, keeps its error
code, and cannot be locked by anything afterwards.
O2  Only the worker holding the lease can give an event up, and only for
a reason on the allow-list.
O3  The migration gives up the events already stuck on
NoEligibleConfidenceClip and leaves every other event as it was.
why: 0487, founder 2026-10-20; runs in one rolled-back transaction on a database whose name starts with ``willab_confident_moment_`` (rehearsal tier only).

story: As the founder, I want a coach-imported recording processed only under my written corpus basis (N58) and never under a speaker's own permit, so that every provider call on the critical path (record -> process) has a lawful basis and a speaker's Take is never processed without their own acceptance.
outcomes:
O1  The basis is one N58 row with the founder's note, never pooled; it can
only be retired, never edited.
O2  A registered import gets a permit naming N58 and its session; its
events land in the corpus ledger, nothing in the Phase-1 one.
O3  A user's Take, a guest's Take and an owned Take with a forged
"training_import" flag are refused by the corpus writers.
O4  The Phase-1 permit writer refuses a corpus import, even for the
importing coach who has accepted the terms.
O5  With no basis in force, no import is registered and no permit issued.
O6  The service key may only call the entry points; the browser roles
(anon, authenticated) can neither call them nor write the tables.
proves:
O1 -> test_the_basis_is_the_founders_and_only_ever_retired
O2 -> test_a_registered_import_is_permitted_under_n58
O3 -> test_a_users_take_is_refused
test_a_guests_take_is_refused
test_a_forged_import_flag_on_an_owned_take_is_refused
O4 -> test_the_phase1_writer_refuses_a_corpus_import
O5 -> test_no_basis_in_force_refuses_everything
O6 -> test_only_the_service_key_reaches_the_entry_points
why: Migration a_corpus_import_is_processed_under_the_founders_basis.sql (0435; founder 2026-10-07, decisions log N58). Runs the real SQL on the rehearsal tier, lane "confident-moment released".

story: As the founder, I want each corpus speaker to stay in the train or test split they were first given, so that evaluation results are honest.
outcomes:
O1  The app's writer (services.corpus_split.assign_speaker_split) stores a
speaker's split once, and a stored split wins over a later computation.
O2  The stored row cannot be changed or removed: an UPDATE and a DELETE
are refused with CORPUS_SPLIT_IMMUTABLE, so no path can re-shuffle.
why: Migration 0433 (N56.4). Runs only on a disposable database whose name starts with willab_confident_moment_.

story: As the founder, I want each speaker's train/test split to survive even a whole-table wipe (TRUNCATE), so that the separation is never reset by accident.
outcomes:
O1  Every form of TRUNCATE is refused with CORPUS_SPLIT_IMMUTABLE.
O2  Every stored split stays exactly as it was.
proves:
O1, O2 -> test_a_truncate_is_refused_and_every_split_stays
(plain, CASCADE and RESTART IDENTITY)
why: N56.4: a split is "never re-shuffled" (migration 0434).

story: As a speaker who asks to delete my account, I want my processing to stop at once, seven days to change my mind, and everything erased after that, so that deletion is real and only briefly reversible.
outcomes:
O1  The request blocks me at once, cancels running jobs and permits,
takes my coached pairs out of training, deletes nothing yet, and ends
seven days later; asking twice is one request.
O2  I can cancel inside the seven days and the block lifts; asking again
later starts a new request.
O3  After the seven days the run erases my data, marks the request done
with proof, and never does it twice.
O4  A dry run only reports what is due and writes nothing.
O5  Once it is done, my sign-in is gone: no email, no phone, no password,
no linked sign-in, no live session, and I cannot sign in; what the
policy says survives (the proof of my agreement, my training choice) is
still there, and nobody else's sign-in is touched. If my sign-in cannot
be erased, the deletion is not marked done and the next run finishes
it. An account deleted before this was fixed loses its sign-in on the
next run.
why: Founder 2026-10-05, N48.4 Q14 A, Q17 A, Q19 A (migration 0422); Privacy 3.8 sections 7 and 9, N217 item 4 and N95 (migration 0497).

story: As a speaker who withdrew my training "yes", I want a half-finished export that held my pair voided and cleaned up, so that my data never leaves in a broken release.
outcomes:
O1  When an export's last step is refused because a pair is no longer
allowed, the release is voided as "export_failed" and queued for
file cleanup.
O2  Pairs of speakers who still say yes wait and leave in a later week's
release.
O3  The weekly consent refresh keeps the "export_failed" reason.
why: Door 2, ML-9 (migration 0455).

story: As a speaker, I want encouragement lines to rotate, and "Your voice moved more here than on Take 1." said only when it is measurably true and never twice in a row, so that feedback feels earned and fresh.
outcomes:
O1  On Take 1 the ordinary lines rotate, one after another.
O2  On Take 2 the "more than on Take 1" line appears only when that cue
was weaker on Take 1.
O3  That line is never said twice in a row; the rotation carries on
after it.
why: D-FW-3; signed line bank, "Rotation" (migration 0438).

story: As a speaker, I want the model trained only on my coached pairs that I said yes to and that were released, and only once, so that my "no" is respected.
outcomes:
O1  A released pair that is still allowed is marked trained, once.
O2  A pair that is not released, no longer allowed, or already trained
is refused.
O3  An unknown training run is refused.
why: Doors 3 and 4 (migration 0406).

story: As a speaker, I want a clip I shared for listening to vanish from the shared list as soon as I withdraw it, so that I control who hears me.
outcomes: O1  A share with revoked_at set leaves shared_clips_live at once.
why: Migration 0410 (F3). The Voice Album share switch is RETIRED (services/lend_your_ear.py docstring): the app no longer writes voice_album_shares, so the revocation is written here by hand, and the view's one reader (delayed_measure.clips_for_listener) has no caller. The live sharing path is pinned in test_a_take_may_be_shared_with_a_community_postgres.py. Candidate for deletion together with its lane entry in scripts/rehearsal_tier.sh.

story: As a coach, I want to know whether a speaker's request came from the open moment or from a judgement, recorded once, so that I answer in the right context.
outcomes:
O1  request_exercise_from_coach_v3 records raised_on; a repeat on the same
moment keeps the first request.
O2  A raised_on outside judgement/open is refused by name
(EXERCISE_COACH_REQUEST_INPUT_INVALID).
O3  Opening a moment is logged once: the app's writer
(DatabaseService.record_moment_event) reports True the first time and
False on a repeat, and one row is stored.
why: Migration 0408 (F1). Runs only on a disposable database whose name starts with willab_confident_moment_.

story: As a speaker who never edited my Ideal Text, I want my document to get paragraph identity when it is published, so that feedback and slides attach to my paragraphs and the screen is not empty.
outcomes:
O1  Publishing a never-edited document writes one part per paragraph, each
with its own id, and the words are unchanged.
O2  A second publish of the same document writes nothing; the ids stay.
O3  A document that already has its own parts is never rewritten.
O4  A document whose paragraphs cannot be proven gets no parts; the words
are still published unchanged.
proves:
O1 -> test_a_never_edited_document_gets_one_part_per_paragraph
O2 -> test_a_second_publish_writes_nothing
O3 -> test_a_document_with_its_own_parts_is_never_rewritten
O4 -> test_an_unprovable_split_writes_no_parts
why: Production 2026-09-19: `parts=0 pieces=3` -- nothing ever minted identity, so V3 feedback and the slide join were dark.

story: As a speaker, I want my training "yes" to count only for the wording I actually agreed to, so that a new consent sentence needs my new yes.
outcomes:
O1  One call retires the old wording and starts the new one at the same
instant; exactly one wording is in force, with the signed sentence.
O2  A yes given under the old wording now reads as off: no new yes to
the old wording, and no training copy made on it.
O3  The old yes stays on record as it was and can still be withdrawn.
why: Founder D3, N68 (migration 0458).

story: As a speaker, I want my coached pairs released for training only while my yes is active, and pulled back if I withdraw, so that withdrawing really stops their use.
outcomes:
O1  A pair is allowed into training only while my training yes is
active; withdrawing turns it off.
O2  A pair leaves once: a released pair cannot be released again.
O3  Withdrawing voids the release that carried my pair and returns the
pair; the release keeps its record.
why: Founder 2026-09-30, L1, L2, L5 (migration 0405).

story: As a speaker practising, I want each try read once, quickly, against my own practice and Take, so that feedback on the try arrives fast, belongs to me, and its number never reaches me.
outcomes:
O1  One stored read per try; the database takes the owner, practice and
Take from the try itself and computes W and S*W; a repeat is a no-op.
O2  A read that fails (services.v4_practice_read.record) still keeps its
row, with no values, and counts as "not reached yet".
O3  The phone's times are stored once, only for the try's owner, and only
for a wait within 0..600 000 ms; the timing route answers 204 with no
body, so the speaker is told nothing about the read (Never rule 1:
no numbers shown to speakers).
O4  The read goes when the try goes (deletion: FK cascade).
proves:
O1 -> test_the_read_is_stored_once_with_its_owner
O2 -> test_a_failed_read_keeps_an_empty_row
O3 -> test_phone_times_are_kept_once_for_the_owner_and_never_answered
O4 -> test_the_read_goes_with_the_try
why: Migration 0450 (V4 B1.4, D-ML-9; founder O5, V7 A). The app's writers run over a thin RPC-to-SQL client on the rehearsal tier.

story: As a speaker, I want my Take processed without a long wait when there is nothing to praise structurally, so that I get to my feedback sooner.
outcomes:
O1  With no device anywhere, the praise pass asks the model about at most
three waves of three pieces (nine calls), in document order, then
stops; nothing is stored.
O2  A Take whose first pieces carry devices stores exactly those pieces,
without asking about the rest.
why: Founder 2026-10-14 (the wait). Driven through the public generate_praise_for_session; only the provider call (chat_complete), the Take's readout and the cross-Take baseline are faked.

story: As a speaker sharing a Take with a community, I want the exact sharing words I agreed to recorded with my share, and kept after I revoke, so that there is proof of what I consented to (consent on the critical path).
outcomes:
O1  A share stamps the consent (Privacy/Terms) version and the words
version on one row per Take and community.
O2  A revocation (fewer communities, or "None") stamps revoked_at and
keeps both versions.
O3  Sharing again under newer words re-stamps the same row and makes it
live again.
O4  A words version the server does not list (Config.SHARE_WORDS_VERSIONS)
is refused and no row is written.
why: Migration 0443 (CM2 B, N53.2; Q-B6 A, N62). The real services.communities.share_take and services.db writers run over a thin PostgREST-to-SQL client on the rehearsal tier. The queue dropping a revoked Take is pinned in test_a_take_may_be_shared_with_a_community_postgres.py.

story: As a speaker, I want the recording screen to use the server's minimum-speech threshold, so that a short but valid Take is not rejected.
outcomes:
O1  /config/recording serves no minimum duration and 3 s of voiced
speech: the same thresholds the upload gate enforces.
O2  The upload gate passes a short, fully voiced Take and refuses the same
length of silence.
why: Founder 2026-07-15: the duration minimum was retired; the FE used to hardcode 60 s. (Formerly tests/test_wave2_be.py.)

story: As a speaker who deletes my account after skipping helper words, I want the erasure to finish, with my skip kept only as an empty receipt, so that deletion never gets stuck and nothing I wrote survives.
outcomes:
O1  The account erasure reaches "done": my skip stays with an empty
payload and my paragraph text reads "[erased]".
O2  Someone else's skip is untouched.
O3  During an erasure, any change to the skip other than emptying it,
and any delete, is refused.
why: Before 0448 the erasure failed on the skip (founder N12, "empty receipt").

story: As a speaker, I want to change my answer to a piece of feedback with my first answer kept exactly as it was, so that both my choice and its history are kept.
outcomes:
O1  A change is stored as a new revision; the same change again changes
nothing; changing back is revision 2.
O2  The first answer's row is unchanged, and the revision list holds
both changes.
why: D-FW-9, founder QA1 A (migration 0440).

story: As the founder, I want each Take's random evaluation moments drawn by the database exactly as the code draws them, so that the evaluation sample is reproducible and unbiased.
outcomes:
O1  The database picks the same moments, in the same order and number,
as the code does for the Take's seed.
O2  Each stored moment records its rank, seed, frame, slide and draw
version.
why: V4 B1.2, D-ML-7; founder V2 A, V3 A (migration 0447).

story: As the founder, I want an imported corpus clip transcribed only under my corpus basis (N58), and a speaker's or guest's Take never under it, so that no Take is processed without its own lawful basis (processing authorization on the record -> process step).
outcomes:
O1  An ordinary or guest Take goes the Phase-1 way (its owner's receipt);
refused there, the transcriber is never called and the corpus basis
is never asked.
O2  An import goes the corpus way: one corpus permit for the session, the
transcriber is called, its events are recorded, and no Phase-1 permit
is ever asked for.
O3  When the database refuses the corpus permit, or names any basis but
N58, the import is refused with that code and the transcriber is
never called.
why: Founder 2026-10-07, CO2, decisions log N58. The database client is a stand-in that only answers each RPC; the SQL rules themselves (who is an import, which basis is in force) run for real in tests/test_a_corpus_import_is_processed_under_the_founders_basis_postgres.py. Was tests/test_corpus_queue_end_to_end.py.

story: As a speaker, I want a Take I shared to leave the community the moment I revoke it or the community closes, so that I stay in control of who hears me.
outcomes:
O1  A shared Take shows in the community's live list.
O2  Revoking the share removes it.
O3  Closing the community removes it.
why: N52.4 (migration 0432).

story: As a speaker, I want each Take 2 rewrite of my Ideal Text stored as a Paragraph revision tied to that Take, with my locked helper words still locked afterwards, so that every old version stays in my history.
outcomes:
O1  Never-5: a take_rewrite revision is kept beside the older ones and
names its Take; the Ideal Text read points at it as the current one.
O2  The Ideal Text read takes a Paragraph's lock from the Paragraph row, so
a locked Paragraph stays locked after a Take rewrite and an unlocked one
is not locked by an old 'lock' revision.
why: 0416 (contract 14, 16): the core read used the newest revision as the lock, so Take 2 unlocked a locked Paragraph on the cold open. The Take-2 writer itself is proven in test_take_two_rewrites_an_edited_slide_postgres.py.

story: As a speaker who asks to delete my account, I want the erasure to actually start and run to the end, so that a request never sits at "requested" with nothing erased.
outcomes:
O1  A list of my data that is not really mine (forged or stale) is
refused.
O2  With the retention rules in place, the erasure runs to "done" and my
practice rows are gone.
O3  Without the deletion-evidence retention rule, the run stops for
review and names only that missing rule.
why: Founder 2026-09-25, decision 6: every deletion sat at "requested" (migration 0362).

story: As a speaker, I want to change my email and my password on Data & consent, with a link for a forgotten password, so that I keep my account when I lose an address or a password; and as the founder, I want every request, change and wrong password kept in a security log, so that a taken-over account can be traced.
outcomes:
O1  Change email: a wrong current password changes nothing and is logged;
the right one sends a link to the new address and a notice to the old
one, and the email stays until the link is opened. The log keeps the
token's SHA-256, never the token, and never a password.
O2  An address another account has is refused before any link goes, and
the refusal is logged.
O3  The link changes the email once and logs it; opened twice it changes
nothing more. An older link after a newer request, an expired link and
an unknown token change nothing.
O4  Change password: a wrong current password or one under 6 characters
changes nothing; the right one sets the new password, signs out the
other devices, sends the notice and is logged with the IP address and
the device.
O5  An account that signs in with Google has no password to ask for: its
email change needs none, Set a password sends the set email, and the
saved password is logged as its first; a reset link's password is a
change and gets the notice.
O6  When the email doesn't go, the card is told so: nothing is reported
as sent.
proves:
O1 -> test_an_email_change_waits_for_the_link_from_the_new_address
O2 -> test_an_address_with_an_account_is_refused_before_any_link
O3 -> test_the_link_changes_the_email_once_and_only_the_newest
O4 -> test_a_password_change_checks_the_current_one_and_signs_out_the_rest
O5 -> test_a_google_account_sets_its_first_password_with_a_link
O6 -> test_an_email_that_didnt_go_is_not_reported_as_sent
why: WIL-95 (founder 2026-10-26, N190: "approved, implement it"; rules in the frontend's docs/flows/consent-screens.md §1).

story: As the founder, I want "Delete" on the Users list and on a profile to delete any account, an old one that never agreed to processing included, and to delete again after an Undo, so that the people I delete are really deleted.
outcomes:
O1  An account with no owner principal is given one and gets the same
pending seven-day deletion as everyone else; its sign-in record is
never deleted outright. The person then leaves the Users list.
O2  Deleting again after a cancel records a new pending deletion, not the
cancelled one.
why: Founder 2026-10-28 (N222): the list's Delete failed with a 500 for an account from May; Supabase refuses to delete a sign-in record whose Takes are kept as history. "Make Delete really delete".

story: As a speaker, I want any AI call an admin makes about me to run under my own processing permit, and be refused when I have none, so that my words never reach a provider without my authority (processing authorization on the critical path).
outcomes:
O1  Directive suggestions: with my authority the model call runs inside
the protected scope bound to MY principal; a refused permit answers
403 before any provider client exists.
O2  Icebreaker regenerate: with my authority it runs inside my scope;
without it the route answers 403 and the model is never called.
O3  No principal is minted for me: the fake database has no create method.
why: Founder 2026-10-05, N48.1 step 6: "every AI call carries its permission slip"; the two admin tools called the provider with none.

story: As the founder, I want each Take on a person's admin page to show what was said, and to export the full text to a CSV only for speakers who said yes to training, so that I can look for verbal patterns without taking words the speaker never agreed to share.
outcomes:
O1  A Take row carries a one-line preview of its transcript, cut at a word,
never the whole text.
O2  Without the training yes the export releases no text.
O3  With the training yes it releases each Take's full transcript, and
leaves out a Take of a project the speaker archived or erased.
why: Founder 2026-10-26 (WIL-110): "Go with the training-yes gate, and build the transcript column". Privacy 3.7 section 4 lets the person who runs WillpowerLab see transcripts; it names no export of them.

story: As the founder, I want each Take on a person's admin page to show its willfidence, so I can read how a speaker's Takes are going.
outcomes:
O1  A Take row carries `willfidence`: the mean of its pieces' willfidence in
whole percent, counting only pieces with a sound read; none when no piece
has one (never the middle of the scale made up).
why: Founder 2026-10-21 (N105): "add the willfidence column here (in the ceo panel but only here)".

story: As the founder, I want a person whose account is being deleted to leave the Users list at once, though their data is deleted only after seven days, so that the list shows only the people who are still here.
outcomes:
O1  The list leaves out everyone whose account is being deleted, whether
the founder deleted it or the person did, and the next page starts
where this one ended. A finished deletion is left out too.
why: Founder 2026-10-27 (N219; N221 drops the "Being deleted" view).

story: As the founder, I want a finished deletion gone from the Users list, so that the list never shows an emptied account with no email and no name.
outcomes:
O1  Every auth user whose deleted_at is set is left out of the paged list
and of the search; one without it stays. A page shortened by a deleted
account still says there is more, so the list does not end early.
why: N219: a finished deletion is in neither tab. N218: its auth record stays, emptied, with deleted_at set.

story: As a speaker, after a Take I want one thing to do at a time: the Take's card and its summary, then each ask on its own with Will's words leading into it, and only then "practice makes perfect" with "Record Take N", so that nothing competes with the walk or with recording again (founder 2026-10-20, N89).
outcomes:
O1  One ask after each Take, the first that waits (founder 2026-10-26,
N189; was two, N94). After Take 1 that is WhatsApp when I left no
number (N171), else Will's question when he has one, else "Did this
help?" when the Take looks off; never an ask from the CEO panel or
the home screen on Take 1.
O2  From Take 2 the order is the CEO panel's ask, WhatsApp (at most twice
in all), the home screen (once, where the phone can add it), Will's
question, "Did this help?"; the first that waits comes and the others
wait for a later Take; nothing comes when nothing applies.
O3  The asks come one at a time, each under whatever closed the one
before: a typed turn, under Will's reply; "Yes", tapped or typed,
under "We're glad it helped you."; a reply that opens a form keeps the
ask open. An ask that no longer applies is skipped. After the last,
the closing message comes, with its words.
O4  A message still waiting when a newer Take is written shows where it
stands.
O5  After a distressed message the chat's safety reply comes and the asks
wait: nothing lands under it until I write again (founder 2026-10-21,
N94).
why: Founder 2026-10-20: "one action at a time", then, after checking the app: the summary without the CTA, Will's liaison before each ask, "Look, practice makes perfect…" and the CTA last.

story: As a speaker practising, I want an AI clip of my own voice saying my own words with one improvement, never shown if it fails its check, and fully deleted when I ask, so that I hear a believable better version and keep control of my voice.
outcomes:
O1  One problem is picked against my own usual (or the default), and the
sentence under the clip names it in words, with no numbers.
O2  The clip says my own words (or the clearer version I accepted, with
the ums taken out), in at most 17 seconds.
O3  A clip that fails its check is made once more with a new seed and
is never shown; a try after it is not scored; a real pause heard in
the audio passes.
O4  One clip per practice, started early once the exercise is known,
